pre_training_architecture_contract.completion_evidence_rule: A backlog item cannot become pre-training ready from prose, a schema, a happy-path fixture, a callable sidecar, or a toy proxy presented as the target mechanism. It requires canonical-path integration, registry ownership, content-bound source/config identity, checkpoint round trip when stateful, fresh-process replay, migration and rollback, resource bounds, positive/negative/adversarial/mutation tests, independent integrity, cleanup, and an explicit frozen-campaign disposition. Disabled mechanisms must prove zero optimizer exposure and fail closed against silent activation.
pre_training_architecture_contract.negative_verdict_adequacy_rule: A negative verdict is scoped to the exact implementation and regime tested. Broad falsification or architecture retirement requires an independent adequacy audit proving mechanism fidelity, learnability and gradient-flow sanity, strong matched baselines, matched data/compute/tuning/inference/verifier opportunity, source-disjoint independent evaluation, multiple seeds, uncertainty and weak-tail reporting, and sufficient power for the preregistered useful effect. Hand-coded proxies, linear probes, authored templates, missing learned stages, underpowered runs, or evaluator construct gaps are INCONCLUSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION or INCONCLUSIVE_EXPERIMENT and cannot retire the full mechanism. Campaign exclusion for sequencing or cost is not scientific falsification.
pre_training_architecture_contract.architecture_change_intake_rule: The 2026-07-22 T0A docket is the final pre-training architecture intake for this cycle: adequate MTP, target-authoritative drafting, learned dynamic byte patches, RDC-enhanced KERC, and native MLX optimizer challengers. A later item enters only when it exposes a correctness defect in this docket or supplies primary evidence for a materially different mechanism strong enough to justify delaying the replacement freeze.
pre_training_architecture_contract.sequence_rule: Closed T0A candidate docket -> faithful implementation behind existing registry abstractions -> candidate-specific adequacy and resource canaries -> matched factorized bakeoff -> content-addressed replacement architecture freeze -> joint campaign preregistration -> long training -> frozen utility evaluation -> causal amplifier qualification.
pre_training_architecture_contract.rule: Architecture readiness requires every architecture prerequisite and every finite cross-phase pre-training backlog contract to be fully wired, implemented, falsified, or retired before long optimizer spend. Training, empirical product qualification, public calibration, real-use evidence, and behavior-dependent efficacy remain follow-through rather than circular prerequisites, but their model, objective, state, checkpoint, routing, memory, verifier, resource, migration, rollback, and evaluation interfaces must already exist when later adoption would invalidate the campaign.
pre_training_architecture_contract.freeze_package_rule: Before long training, publish one independently replayed content-addressed architecture-freeze package binding topology and ownership, representation and context, objectives and update causality, generation and deliberation dispositions, execution and autonomy, evaluation contracts, state portability, registry identities, source/configuration digests, rollback routes, evidence refs, and non-claims. A matrix status or self-declared GREEN report alone cannot grant training authority.
pre_training_architecture_contract.allowed_before_freeze: Implementation, integration, deterministic replay, negative testing, migration testing, checkpoint round trips, and isolated candidate-specific adequacy runs are allowed. The existing eight-step guard remains the fail-closed default until T0A implements a preregistered canary authority with hard position, wall-time, seed, memory, disk, and heldout boundaries. Full-corpus optimizer work, mutation of the durable control checkpoint, public calibration, confirmation-surface consumption, and capability claims are not.
pre_training_architecture_contract.no_shortcut: A phase or backlog item may postpone only evidence that intrinsically requires a prerequisite behavior, exact-once public calibration, real-use time, or a literally unavailable external peer/device. Resource pressure on a critical local model, data, KERC, memory, routing, verifier, checkpoint, evaluation, or serving path creates an optimization or redesign blocker and cannot close as deferred. Missing contracts, authority, memory, evidence, deterministic tooling, runtime, migration, security, checkpoint lineage, campaign preregistration, objective plumbing, reproducibility, or governance remain architecture blockers. A speculative item may be adequately scope-retired before training; it may not remain vaguely planned and then silently invalidate the frozen run.
pre_training_architecture_contract.whole_system_qualification_rule: Every selected canonical subsystem must pass correctness, learned-component adequacy where applicable, exact state custody, sustained performance/resource profiling, canonical-path integration, fresh-environment reproduction, and direct functional or real-use evidence. Wired, implemented, mechanics-only, and resource-deferred are intermediate states rather than completion states.

implementation_rules: Improve an existing registered surface before creating a new surface.
Bind every phase to an abstraction, implementation, and VIEA execution-spine hook before claiming it is wired.
Do not call a phase implemented from prose, private 1.0 scores, or self-declared flags alone.
Every completed phase must leave runnable gates, evidence reports, docs, and typed failure behavior.
Book-derived phases 13-19 are preserved; they may be sequenced, narrowed, or scaffolded, but not deleted from the roadmap.
At most one flagship implementation lane may be active at a time; other lanes can do maintenance, evidence sync, or narrow dependency work only.
Every capability statement must carry a support state: argument, prototype-backed, synthetic-test-backed, empirical-test-backed, or replayable-reference-backed.
Every authored AI_book chapter must map to a Theseus implementation slice with a minimum slice, beyond-SOTA endpoint, support-state target, no-claim boundary, and gate or fixture.

AI_book chapter-level Planned Codex tests are treated as missing technique obligations until a registered Theseus implementation has matched controls, negative controls, no-cheat audit, retained residuals, and explicit non-claims.

Negative, inconclusive, and regression evidence must remain attached to the exact implementation and regime it constrains; do not replace a negative report with a nearby positive family or generalize a proxy failure into a mechanism failure.

Any retirement or falsification requires a decision-grade adequacy receipt covering mechanism fidelity, learnability, optimization, matched opportunity, evaluation independence, statistical power, uncertainty, weak tails, and exact claim scope. Missing adequacy yields INCONCLUSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION or INCONCLUSIVE_EXPERIMENT, never a broad negative claim.

The finite architecture and acceleration docket is complete and independently replayed. Primary work may return to the selected English/code neural seed only after the separate broader pre-training architecture-readiness gate names zero hard blockers; do not reopen elective acceleration or architecture intake.

AI_book technique recommendations are coverage obligations, but if a technique has already produced clean negative behavior evidence, the roadmap must route to the lower-level wall before retrying it.

The v8 prompt/target comparison is an exact-recovery diagnostic because its rows do not carry complete functional verifiers; practical architecture selection requires a separately frozen source-disjoint functional utility surface.

After the finite pre-training docket and revised joint campaign are wired, freeze architecture and control-plane breadth for three capability cycles; only a concrete correctness, security, replay, migration, checkpoint, or measured training/inference defect may authorize another architecture change.

Treat 10.8M active parameters as a systems-canary rung. If sparse and both dense controls remain functionally zero across code, close the rung and require task-complete data plus a preregistered 50M-100M scale proposal instead of another same-scale patch.

Treat OneCell-RWM as a pre-training architecture-disposition candidate: its shared ABI, exact substrate, checkpoint/objective interfaces, and matched campaign decision must close before the long run, but it cannot become a same-scale rescue patch, duplicate VIEA/VCM/Octopus/SCF/Loop-Closure/SparkStream/registry machinery, or receive route authority before a preregistered matched total-cost verdict.

book_chapter_implementation_crosswalk.beyond_sota_theseus_endpoint: The bibliography endpoint is a source and research graph for the entire ASI Stack. The bibliography would not be an afterthought at the end of the book, and it would not blur Corben's papers, Corben-supplied materials, recovered project records, or local project sources with outside literature. It would be the routing table that tells future agents which ideas have sources, which sources have been read, which chapters they affect, which proof or experiment backlogs they create, which material is external, and which claims still cannot move. A mature source graph would give every paper, project, local note, external reference, conversation-mined packet, recovery item, and missing source a public-safety policy, ingestion state, source note, chapter assignments, deduplication status, evidence-transition preconditions, proof/test backlog, citation status, and non-claims. New material would update the research graph before it changes manuscript prose.
